report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 71ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. One trace shows a 1011ms ERROR span on gateway->inventory, but inventory's own telemetry is absent, so no bounded root cause is established. Handing off for downstream inventory/redis evidence.
missing_evidence: Inventory service metrics (error rate, latency, timeouts) for the alert window
Inventory logs and traces for the failing call
Redis dependency metrics/latency from inventory to substantiate redis-timeout
Order service telemetry to confirm whether errors propagate from inventory
Confirmation of whether the single ERROR span is representative or isolated
